package.name: varietas_urdf
package.description: The URDF front end: a robot description written in decimal becomes a chain over the exact rational field, or is refused with the joint that could not be represented. Rotations are recovered projectively from their quaternions, which makes every multiple of a right angle exact, and every recovery is reported with the angle between the exact robot and the stated one. Offline only; nothing here is needed at runtime.
